overall.summary: Practice Fusion EHR exposes a clearly native TSV export model with broad domain coverage and strong field-level documentation, but it remains partially constrained by missing explicit relationship/value-set/constraint metadata and by weaker evidence for downstream payment/claims lifecycle and binary document payload handling.

notableFacts: The v9 index explicitly states manual export support for a single patient or entire patient population in TSV format.
The collected v9 dictionary corpus covers 85 TSV entities and 1,165 documented fields.
The main EHI documentation page lists active versioning from v1 (Nov 27, 2023) through v9 (Jan 12, 2026).
Clinical note content is directly represented via encounter SOAP fields (Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan) and encounter addendums.
Billing capture is strong at the superbill layer, but explicit submission/adjudication/remittance/payment-posting entities are not clearly documented.
One dictionary page (patient-drug-alert-overrides) includes an 'etc.' placeholder row with blank datatype/description, indicating minor documentation quality drift.
